title: Privacy Policy
description: How Local Key in Elbridge, NY handles website visits and car key service inquiries.
body:
This page describes the information involved in visiting the Local Key website and asking about car key cutting or programming in Elbridge, NY.

## Service inquiries

If you contact us, the information you choose to share may include your name, contact details, location, vehicle year, make and model, and whether you have a working key. We use inquiry information to respond, check compatibility and availability, discuss a quote, and arrange the requested service.

## Website visits

The appointment form prepares a text message on your device. The details you enter are not submitted to or stored by this website. You review the message and send it using your texting app; your messaging provider handles that message. An appointment request is confirmed only when Local Key replies. This website does not provide customer accounts or online payments. Website hosting can involve technical request information, such as IP addresses, browser details and requested pages.

## Analytics and browser storage

This website does not currently include analytics or advertising trackers. The appointment form does not save your details in browser storage. See the cookie policy for more information.

## Questions

For questions about information you have shared with Local Key, use the business contact details provided on the website. Include enough information for us to identify the relevant inquiry without sending unnecessary vehicle documents.

## Updates

This page will be updated when the website's features or handling of service inquiries changes.
